Subject: Security & VPC deployment follow-up — ACME (SOC 2, GDPR, SQ)

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Current ask: ACME needs a private deployment option (VPC or on-prem) that can meet GDPR controls and support a SOC 2 Type II report for vendor assessments.
- Primary technical concerns you raised: network isolation (no egress to public internet by default), key management (KMS/HSM), audit logs retention, and ability to run in an air-gapped environment for certain regulated workloads.
- Info we said we'd provide: copy of our latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), a VPC deployment diagram and example network ACLs, and a completed vendor security questionnaire.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Please share the security questionnaire and any specific diagram/format you prefer — we can complete the SQ and return by EOD Wed (Jul 22).
2) We'll attach the SOC 2 report and a draft VPC deployment diagram for your architecture/security team to review.
3) Optional: schedule a 30-min follow-up with your infra/security folks to walk the diagram and discuss air-gapped options — do mornings on Jul 24 or Jul 25 work?

I'll assign Marissa to own the SQ and Dylan to assemble the VPC diagram and runbook.

Thanks — talk soon.
—Marcus

Marcus —

Thanks for the recap. Confirming a few priorities from ACME's side:
- We need a vendor with an up-to-date SOC 2 Type II report and a clear process for timely re-releases (we have a quarterly vendor review cadence).
- GDPR: data residency + ability to delete datasets on request are must-haves.
- For the high-security environment: the deployment needs to be VPC-isolated with no outbound internet access except to explicitly whitelisted endpoints (we can provide a whitelist later).

I've attached our baseline vendor security questionnaire (ACME_Security_SQ.xlsx) — please complete and return. Also: can Redwood provide a redacted SOC 2 report and a sample VPC deployment diagram (network zones, restricted admin egress points, where KMS sits)?

We'd like to loop in our infra lead, Bob Reed, on the follow-up call. Morning PST on Jul 24 works for us.

Thanks —
Alice Johnson

Alice —

Appreciate the priorities and thanks for sending the SQ. We completed the questionnaire and attached it here, and I'm also attaching a redacted copy of our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redwood_soc2_report_v3.pdf).

Notes on a few items you called out:
- Data residency / GDPR: We support region-specific private deployments and can configure storage/processing in your preferred cloud region. We also support data deletion workflows and can map them to your DPIA requests (we'll include the data retention and deletion runbook in the follow-up docs).
- VPC / egress: Our VPC deployment supports strict egress controls and can be provisioned with no outbound internet access except to customer-approved endpoints (we'll provide a sample whitelist and network ACLs).
- KMS/HSM: We integrate with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure KeyVault) and can support HSM-backed keys where required.
- Air-gapped/on-prem: We offer an on-prem package for fully air-gapped installs; it includes an offline installer and an ops runbook. There are additional professional services for initial setup and operational handoff.

Attachments included: completed_ACME_Security_SQ.xlsx (filled), redwood_soc2_report_v3.pdf, draft_vpc_diagram_v2.png. Dylan will follow up with a short runbook and a table of required firewall rules and ports.

Confirming: follow-up call — Jul 24, 2026 at 10:00 AM PST (I will send a calendar invite).

If you or Bob have any immediate questions after reviewing the attachments, reply here and we'll jump in.

Best,
—Marcus
